name: Earthen Redoubt · Fire
primary: A 2-high half ring of wall with a 3-block radius facing the aim point: the top of the arc stands where you aim, each column settling on the ground. Material: magic earth, permanent.
self_description:
A 2-high half ring of wall with a 3-block radius facing the aim point: the top of the arc stands where you aim, each column settling on the ground. Material: magic earth, permanent. On you:
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
